field.label: Enable
field.comment: Enable or disable the Pigeon Express shipping carrier.

field.label: Carrier Title
field.comment: Default carrier title (can be overridden per store).

field.label: Displayed Error Message
field.comment: Message shown when the method is unavailable.

field.label: Who Pays the Shipping
field.comment:
Who Pigeon Express invoices for the shipping. This can be changed per shipment on the order screen.
It does not change what the customer is charged at checkout. Pigeon Express quotes the same price either way, so if you choose Receiver the courier collects the delivery charge on top of anything Magento has already billed. Set your shipping rate to zero for the affected delivery types, or leave this on Sender.

field.label: Locker Compartment Width (cm)
field.comment: Only the locker compartment is checked here; the other limits come from Pigeon Express when a parcel is priced. Leave a side at 0 to skip the check.

field.label: Override Address Fields
field.comment: With Yes, a customer choosing address delivery picks their city and street from Pigeon Express's lists instead of typing them, so the address always matches what we hold. With No, Magento's standard address fields are used.

field.label: Checkout Logo
field.comment: Shown beside the Pigeon Express methods at checkout. Two of the versions are drawn in white for dark backgrounds and will be invisible on a light checkout, which is why they say so.

field.label: Location Autocomplete Results
field.comment: Max number of Office/APS results in checkout autocomplete (e.g. 10–20).

field.label: Label Contents
field.comment: What the waybill says the parcel holds. The carrier prints this, so everyone who handles the parcel can read it. A fixed description replaces every product name with one wording and drops the quantities, so the label reads "Contents: Clothing" rather than "Contents: 5 pcs. - Push It Messenger Bag". The insured sum and any cash on delivery travel separately and are unaffected.

field.label: Fixed Description
field.comment: Printed in place of every product name. Something the courier can act on but a bystander learns nothing from, for example "Стоки" or "Дрехи". Left empty, the label reads "Стоки".

group.label: API Setup
group.comment: Credentials and connection to Pigeon Express.

field.label: API Key
field.comment: Pigeon Express API key (X-API-Key).

field.label: API Secret
field.comment: Pigeon Express API secret (X-API-Secret). If empty, API Key is used for both.

field.label: Test Mode
field.comment: Use test/sandbox environment when enabled.

field.label: Enable Logging / Error Handling
field.comment: Log API requests and errors for debugging.

group.label: Additional Services
group.comment: Services applied to every shipment. Prices come from Pigeon Express. Only services in your account are listed, and one the chosen delivery method cannot perform is skipped.

field.label: COD Payment Methods
field.comment: Payment methods that trigger a cash on delivery fee. The fee is set by Pigeon Express and read from the API for every quote.

field.label: Paper Return Receipt
field.comment: Request for a paper return receipt (at sender's expense).

field.label: ID Verification and Document Signature
field.comment: Verify ID and sign documents electronically.

field.label: Special Packaging
field.comment: Requires special packaging (requires_special_packaging). Enable only after Pigeon Express activates this service.

field.label: Insurance (Declared Value)
field.comment: Insure the contents of every parcel. The sum insured is the value of the goods in the order, sent to Pigeon Express.

field.label: Digital Return Receipt
field.comment: Request for a return receipt in electronic format.

field.label: Service Return Documents
field.comment: Return of original documents from the recipient to the sender after signing.

group.label: Address Delivery
group.comment: Door to door delivery to the address the customer enters.

field.label: Enable
field.comment: Enable delivery to address.

field.label: Title
field.comment: Label shown at checkout for this delivery type.

field.label: Flat Rate Price
field.comment: Charged instead of asking the API for a price. Cleared automatically if Pricing Mode is switched back to Dynamic.

field.label: Enable Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: A cart price rule with the Free Shipping action still applies whether or not this is on.

field.label: Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: Order subtotal, after discounts, at or above which this delivery type costs nothing. Set Who Pays to Sender as well, or the courier still collects the charge on delivery. Cleared automatically if the threshold is switched off.

field.label: Sort Order
field.comment: Position among the Pigeon Express options at checkout. Lower shows first.

field.label: Recipient Inspection
field.comment: Let the recipient check the parcel before paying. Inspection only allows looking; Inspection and testing also allows trying the product. Only one is ever requested. Not available for parcel locker delivery.

group.label: Office Delivery
group.comment: Delivery to a Pigeon Express counter office chosen by the customer.

field.label: Enable Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: A cart price rule with the Free Shipping action still applies whether or not this is on.

field.label: Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: Order subtotal, after discounts, at or above which this delivery type costs nothing. Set Who Pays to Sender as well, or the courier still collects the charge on delivery. Cleared automatically if the threshold is switched off.

field.label: Sort Order
field.comment: Position among the Pigeon Express options at checkout. Lower shows first.

field.label: Recipient Inspection
field.comment: Let the recipient check the parcel before paying. Inspection only allows looking; Inspection and testing also allows trying the product. Only one is ever requested. Not available for parcel locker delivery.

group.label: Parcel Locker (APS) Delivery
group.comment: Delivery to an automated parcel station chosen by the customer.

field.label: Enable Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: A cart price rule with the Free Shipping action still applies whether or not this is on.

field.label: Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: Order subtotal, after discounts, at or above which this delivery type costs nothing. Set Who Pays to Sender as well, or the courier still collects the charge on delivery. Cleared automatically if the threshold is switched off.

field.label: Sort Order
field.comment: Position among the Pigeon Express options at checkout. Lower shows first.

group.label: Pickup Location
group.comment: Where your parcels enter the Pigeon Express network. The office list fills in once your API credentials are saved and locations have synced.

field.label: Pickup Type
field.comment: How your parcels reach us: you drop them off at one of our offices, or our couriers collect them from your address. This is also the origin used when calculating rates.

field.label: Office
field.comment: Search by office name, town or street. You take your parcels to this office yourself, and it is also the origin used to calculate shipping rates.

field.label: City
field.comment: Start typing and choose the city from the Pigeon Express list. The postal code is filled in from it.

field.label: Postal Code
field.comment: Filled in from the city. Only open for typing when Pigeon Express holds no postal code for it.

field.label: Street
field.comment: Choose the city first, then start typing and choose the street. If it is not on the list, type it; it is sent as written.

group.label: Product Weight and Dimensions
group.comment: Which product attributes hold weight and size, and what to fall back on when a product has none.

field.label: Weight Attribute
field.comment: Select product attribute used for package weight (kg). If empty, Magento standard weight field will be used.

field.label: Length Attribute
field.comment: Select product attribute used for package length (cm). If empty, a default value will be used.

field.label: Width Attribute
field.comment: Select product attribute used for package width (cm). If empty, a default value will be used.

field.label: Height Attribute
field.comment: Select product attribute used for package height (cm). If empty, a default value will be used.

field.label: Default Weight (kg)
field.comment: Used when a product has no weight value. Set to 0 to hide shipping methods for products without weight.

field.label: Default Length (cm)
field.comment: Used when a product has no length value. Set to 0 to hide shipping methods for products without dimensions.

field.label: Default Width (cm)
field.comment: Used when a product has no width value. Set to 0 to hide shipping methods for products without dimensions.

field.label: Default Height (cm)
field.comment: Used when a product has no height value. Set to 0 to hide shipping methods for products without dimensions.

group.label: Location Sync
group.comment: Offices, lockers, cities and the service catalogue are refreshed nightly.

field.label: Manual Sync
field.comment: Schedules a manual sync of offices and APS lockers from Pigeon Express API. Runs on the next cron tick (~1 min).
